ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$. Point $D$ is on $AC$, and satisfies $AD^{2}=CD\cdot AC$. If $AD=BC$, by connecting $BD$, what is the measure of $\angle ABD$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AC$,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=\angle ACB$,\\
Since $AD^{2}=CD\cdot AC$, $AD=BC$,\\
it follows that $BC^{2}=CD\cdot AC$,\\
which means $\frac{CB}{CD}=\frac{AC}{CB}$,\\
Also, since $\angle C=\angle C$,\\
it follows that $\triangle CBA\sim \triangle CDB$,\\
thus, $\angle BDC=\angle C=\angle ABC$, $\angle A=\angle DBC$,\\
it follows that $BD=CB$,\\
thus, $DB=DA$,\\
it follows that $\angle A=\angle ABD$,\\
Let $\angle A=\angle ABD =x^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BDC=\angle A+\angle ABD=2x^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=\angle C=2\angle ABD=2x^\circ$,\\
In $\triangle ABC$, by the triangle angle sum theorem,\\
$x+2x+2x=180$,\\
Solving, we find $x=\boxed{36}$,\\
thus, $\angle ABD=36^\circ.$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached diagram shows triangle ABC with A at the top, B at the lower left, and C at the lower right. Point D lies on side AC between A and C, and segment BD is drawn from B to D inside the triangle. Reasoning: Since AB = AC, triangle ABC is isosceles, so ∠ABC = ∠ACB. Given AD^2 = CD·AC and AD = BC, substitute BC for AD to get BC^2 = CD·AC. Thus CB/CD = AC/CB. At C, the angle in triangle CBA equals the angle in triangle CDB because D lies on AC, so the included angle at C is common. Therefore △CBA ∼ △CDB. From the similarity, ∠BDC = ∠CBA and ∠DBC = ∠CAB. Also, the corresponding side relation gives BD = BC, using AB = AC. Since AD = BC, it follows that BD = AD. Hence triangle ABD is isosceles, so ∠ABD = ∠BAD. Let ∠ABD = ∠BAD = x. Because A, D, C are collinear, ∠BDC is the exterior angle of triangle ABD at D, so ∠BDC = x + x = 2x. But ∠BDC = ∠CBA, and ∠CBA = ∠ACB, so the base angles of triangle ABC are both 2x while the apex angle ∠BAC is x. Therefore x + 2x + 2x = 180, so 5x = 180 and x = 36. Thus ∠ABD = 36°.
